title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 21: Home

scenes.say: He buys a house. Not on the block. Not far from it either.
scenes.visual: a modest house with a small yard at golden hour, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His mother walks through every room like it's a museum.
scenes.visual: an older woman touching a kitchen counter in an empty new house, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You did it, baby, she says.
scenes.visual: a mother hugging her grown son in an empty living room, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We did it, Ma. Your porch light brought me home.
scenes.visual: a porch light switching on at dusk outside a new house, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He hangs Roddy's photo in the hallway where everybody sees it.
scenes.visual: a framed photo of two soldiers hanging on a hallway wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The flag goes on the mantle. The bandana goes beside it.
scenes.visual: a folded flag and a red bandana side by side on a fireplace mantle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
the mantle close up, warm firelight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a crowded dinner table with family laughing, warm light, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Home isn't an address. It's where you stop running.
scenes.visual: a man sitting on his new porch steps at sunset, relaxed, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: For the first time in his life, Ali is not running.
scenes.visual: a quiet suburban street at dusk, a porch light glowing, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Two. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a welcome mat at a front door, golden light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 21 of 25: Home. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
